Native functional trajectory registration, dynamics, and anomaly diagnostics

native-parity-core.Rd

Narrow, explicitly specified native R methods for prespecified piecewise-linear landmark registration, delay embeddings, threshold return maps, binary recurrence-network summaries, and split-conformal anomaly screening. An offline catalog identifies optional R package backends. No Python is used.

Usage

etr_register_landmarks(x, source_landmarks, target_landmarks)

etr_registration_warp_frame(registration)

etr_delay_embedding(series, dimension = 2L, delay = 1L)

etr_poincare_return_map(series, threshold = 0,
    direction = c("up", "down"), time = NULL)

etr_recurrence_network_nodes(network)

etr_split_conformal_threshold(calibration_scores, alpha = 0.10)

etr_fpca_reconstruction_scores(fit, x)

etr_split_conformal_fpca_anomalies(fit, calibration, test, alpha = 0.10)

etr_r_backend_catalog()

Arguments

x

Native common-grid trajectories; must match the FPCA fit when scoring.

source_landmarks

Numeric source times, one row per curve, strictly ordered.

target_landmarks

Prespecified, increasing interior target times.

registration

Native landmark registration output.

series

Complete finite numeric sampled series.

dimension

Embedding dimension, positive integer.

delay

Positive integer sample lag.

threshold

Finite scalar crossing threshold.

direction

Upward or downward threshold crossing.

time

Optional finite strictly increasing measurement times.

network

Native recurrence-network result.

calibration_scores

Nonnegative scores from held-out calibration curves.

alpha

Miscoverage fraction strictly between zero and one.

fit

FPCA fitted only to independent training curves.

calibration

Held-out complete calibration trajectory set.

test

Independent complete test trajectory set.

Details

The registration is a deterministic piecewise-linear inverse time map, with endpoints fixed. It is not SRVF elastic registration or a Python parity claim. The canonical recurrence network treats time samples as graph vertices; etr_recurrence_network_nodes() is an explicitly legacy R-only projection that uses one-based component identifiers and missing clustering for nodes of degree less than two. It does not regard recurrence nodes as independent research participants. Theiler exclusions remain ineligible edges. Return maps are scalar threshold-event maps, not Lyapunov or causal estimates.

Split-conformal calibration uses rank ceiling((n_calibration+1)*(1-alpha)); when the rank exceeds the calibration sample size, the cutoff is infinite. Marginal false-alarm coverage requires a frozen training fit and exchangeable calibration/test units. It does not give batch-wide or participant-cluster coverage guarantees, and must not be used to claim calibrated simultaneous functional bands. External R backends listed by etr_r_backend_catalog are optional and have not been independently validated for equivalence.

Value

etr_register_landmarks returns a registration object; etr_registration_warp_frame returns its tidy warp frame; etr_delay_embedding returns a numeric matrix with sample indices; etr_poincare_return_map returns crossing times and adjacent pairs; etr_recurrence_network returns the canonical source-aligned graph; the compatibility function below projects a legacy per-node table from it; etr_recurrence_network_nodes returns per-node metrics; etr_split_conformal_threshold returns threshold/rank metadata; etr_fpca_reconstruction_scores returns residual scores per curve; etr_split_conformal_fpca_anomalies returns scores, flags and calibration; etr_r_backend_catalog returns a local optional-package catalog.

Examples

d <- etr_delay_embedding(1:6, dimension = 3L, delay = 2L)
stopifnot(nrow(d) == 2L, ncol(d) == 3L)
cut <- etr_split_conformal_threshold(1:9, alpha = .1)
stopifnot(cut$rank == 9L, cut$threshold == 9)
head(etr_r_backend_catalog(), 3)
